traversal: Load the two frozen near-deduplicated source manifests in lexicographic sourceId order; within each, traverse document records in lexicographic stableDocumentId order. Resolve only each record's outputPath.

documentValidation.utf8: Read bytes and decode strict UTF-8.
documentValidation.empty: Any zero-byte, empty-text, or zero-token nonempty document fails closed.
documentValidation.manifest: On-disk byte length and SHA-256 must equal the source-manifest record; stable IDs and content hashes must remain unique.
documentValidation.encode: Tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=false); extract ids without truncation or padding.
documentValidation.structural: IDs must be integers, sequence length must be positive, and every ID must be in [0,8191].
documentValidation.determinism: Encode every document twice in the same runtime; ID sequences must be identical.
documentValidation.roundTrip: Decode the first ID sequence with skip_special_tokens=false and require exact Unicode string equality to the decoded source text. This is required because the locked contract and acceptance seal specify lossless byte-level UTF-8 round trip.
documentValidation.unknown: Count occurrences of token ID 3. Any unknown-token occurrence fails closed because the accepted byte-fallback authority reports unknown fallback absent for representative valid UTF-8 and complete lossless round trip is required.

specialTokenPolicy: Do not inject BOS, EOS, PAD, document-boundary, or any other special token. Literal special-token-looking source text is processed according to the serialized tokenizer. Token count is therefore the exact length returned by encode with add_special_tokens=false.

accounting.tokenDefinition: One accepted token is one integer ID in the validated per-document encoding; aggregate accepted tokens are the sum of all 6,106 independent document lengths. No cross-document merge and no separator tokens are counted.
accounting.median: For 6,106 sorted per-document counts, arithmetic mean of one-based positions 3,053 and 3,054.
accounting.sequenceCapacity: Euclidean divmod(TOTAL_ACCEPTED_TOKENS, 2048); no sequence files are created.
accounting.source: Sum document token counts by frozen sourceId.
accounting.language: Before encoding each document, reapply the unchanged D1-DATA-COMPOSITION-POLICY-001 language algorithm; token results cannot influence classification.
accounting.domain: Use unchanged D1-DATA-COMPOSITION-POLICY-001 source rules: Python=code/software documentation; Gesetze=structured factual text.
accounting.reconciliation: Aggregate, source, language, and domain token subtotals must each equal TOTAL_ACCEPTED_TOKENS. Document and byte subtotals must also reconcile.

runtime: Use exactly /Users/dennischarles/Downloads/Denarixx-Frontier-AI/.venv-d1/bin/python and record Python, machine, tokenizers version and module path.
determinism: Single-process CPU tokenization; serialized accepted tokenizer only; no sampling, parallel map, truncation, padding, cache mutation, tokenizer mutation, or corpus mutation.
